description: This bar chart, titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks," visually compares the performance of two models—Llama-3-8B-it (represented by blue bars) and Ours (Iterative RLHF, represented by orange bars)—across nine distinct academic and practical evaluation datasets. The horizontal axis, labeled "Dataset and Metrics," lists the datasets in the order: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis, labeled "Score (%)," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each dataset has two adjacent bars, one for each model, allowing for direct visual comparison of their scores. For the GSM-8K dataset, the blue bar for Llama-3-8B-it reaches approximately 80%, while the orange bar for Ours reaches approximately 81%. For MMLU, the scores are approximately 66% for Llama-3-8B-it and 65% for Ours. On HumanEval, the scores are approximately 61% for Llama-3-8B-it and 64% for Ours. For TruthfulQA, the scores are approximately 44% for Llama-3-8B-it and 60% for Ours. For ARC, the scores are approximately 60% for Llama-3-8B-it and 64% for Ours. For MBPP, the scores are approximately 61% for Llama-3-8B-it and 61% for Ours. For LC AlpacaEval-2, the scores are approximately 23% for Llama-3-8B-it and 31% for Ours. For MT-Bench (x5), the scores are approximately 41% for Llama-3-8B-it and 42% for Ours. For Chat-Arena-Hard, the scores are approximately 21% for Llama-3-8B-it and 30% for Ours. The bars are not sorted; they are presented in the order of the datasets listed on the horizontal axis. There is no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding applied to any specific bar.
